commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka (rank Voh-Vastei) via Nesh-Deeka. Hist trees are sickening, the Unbound are draining sap, and the Eye of Argonia, a jewel at the Root, could heal all trees. The order wants it before Cuts-the-Old-Knot. 2. Go to Gideon market and find the dealer selling an Eye of Argonia; Ovinius Calo is marked and there is a Glass Eye thing here. 3. Talk to Ovinius Calo, persuade or pay him for the truth, or examine the Eye itself. I do not yet know if fighting is needed. 4. I do not know where the Root is exactly, nor if this Eye is real (it says Glass, so maybe fake). I can find out by asking the dealer.

answer 1. The Eye for sale is cheap glass garnet, not the real Eye. Its old silver setting went to smugglers who keep it to melt. Unbound and a Collector (Imperial relic-hunter) also asked after it. The setting may hold a clue to the real Eye. 2. Go to Gideon South Watch, a leaning tower south-east of the quay, and take the silver setting from the locked chest in the inner room. 3. Fight the smugglers, sneak past, pick the chest lock, or kill the boss for the key. As a fighter I favour fighting. 4. I do not know who the Collector is or why the setting matters; I may learn from the setting or the smugglers.

answer 1. I killed the smugglers and took the old silver setting. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, a relic-hunter, opened the chest first and left a note: a ship name is scratched inside the band. That may lead to the real Eye. 2. Take the setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, by rootworm from Gideon Hist garden. 3. Go straight to Nesh-Deeka, or read the note and inspect the band first. 4. I do not know what ship it is or what the Collector wants; I can read the note and ask Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. The Eye in Gideon was glass. Its setting names the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight (east coast, south of Thorn) with a Gideon dealer stock aboard; the real Eye may have gone down with it. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold. The quest is complete. 2. Nothing is set explicitly; the likely next step is the wreck in Hatandros Bight. 3. Ask Nesh-Deeka for more, or head for the Bight. 4. I do not know how the wreck can be reached, and I am uneasy that she knew about the Unbound and would not say how she knows ("we listen").

answer I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka under handler Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The Eye of Argonia on sale in Gideon (dealer Ovinius Calo) was cheap glass. I killed the smugglers at Gideon South Watch and took the Old Silver Setting, which I still carry along with The Collector note and the smuggler key. Inside the band is scratched the name Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight, east coast south of Thorn, with a Gideon dealers whole stock aboard. That is the next lead for the real Eye. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold (I have about 400 or more). The Unbound (Cuts-the-Old-Knot) also hunt the Eye, and two asked about the glass in Gideon a month ago. Ennodius Vanin, the Collector, an Imperial relic-hunter, also hunts it. Nesh-Deeka will not say how she knew about the Unbound ("we listen"). The Eye is meant to be used at the Root to heal the Hist trees. Next: travel to Hatandros Bight and find the wreck.
